content: Lactose intolerance must be carefully distinguished from other medical conditions that can cause diarrhea. These include pancreatic insufficiency, irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), small intestinal bacterial overgrowth (SIBO), celiac disease, and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). It is also essential to differentiate lactose intolerance from other causes of bloating and flatulence. For example, the consumption of beans, which contain the indigestible sugars stachyose and raffinose, can lead to similar symptoms.
